serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Averisys AI Data Analytics Platform is a software-as-a-service decision-intelligence platform hosted on Microsoft Azure. Users upload or connect datasets and run statistical and machine-learning analyses, including classification and prediction, time-series forecasting, time-to-event (survival) analysis, structural equation modeling, causal analysis, segmentation, and qualitative text analysis. The platform adds AI-generated interpretation, risk identification, what-if analysis, and recommendations, with human review steps and a downloadable audit record of each analysis. It is delivered as five domain platforms: Customer Intelligence, Brand Intelligence, Workforce Intelligence, Fraud Intelligence, and Sales Performance Intelligence.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Public FedRAMP page of the Averisys Analytics Trust Center: certification goals and progress, service list, contacts, vulnerability reporting, and links to all published certification files. No sign-in, NDA, or agreement is required.
